## What this changes

- [ ] Adds an entry
- [ ] Fixes or updates an entry
- [ ] Moves an entry to the Graveyard
- [ ] Something else (describe below)

## Checklist for a new entry

- [ ] The project has had a commit or release in the last 24 months.
- [ ] It has documentation beyond a README stub.
- [ ] It is used by a notable downstream project, or is clearly the best option in its niche.
- [ ] The entry follows `- [name](url) \`Language\` - One sentence ending with a period.`
- [ ] It links to the canonical source repository.
- [ ] It is in the right section and not already listed elsewhere.
- [ ] `npx awesome-lint` passes locally.
